> 第七章 开始渡劫（第1页）
在门内，李磊和那石头完美融合了。虽然已经融合成功，但李磊依然盘膝而坐紧闭双眼。
“对了，本女王有些事要告诉你，因为你修为实在太弱，要想飞升成仙，必须要连续渡过阻碍心动期成为结丹期的三九雷劫，和阻碍出窍期成为分身期的六九雷劫，以及阻碍大乘期渡劫成仙的九九雷劫，才能飞升”
“一次雷劫比一次强，更何况以你心动圆满的肉身被本女王强行灌输修为，就算修为达到了大乘圆满你的肉身也不可能是大乘圆满的肉身!而且根据我的推测你好像也没有法宝道具可以兵解的吧”石头又说道。
“这么难!”李磊听到石头的话语竟不由的皱起了眉头。
如果说以李磊现在的肉身渡过三九雷劫的话不算太难，但是六九雷劫，九九雷劫可就不妙了。
而且还真被那石头说对了李磊还真没有可以辅助他渡劫的宝物，准确来说他现在何止是没有宝物啊，就连身上的银两都没有几个。
“当然了，顺者凡，逆为仙!每一次突破，毫无疑问都是一场竞争，因此天道是不会允许你突破这个界限的，所以天道会降下一次劫难来毁灭你，而这个劫难就是所谓的天劫，与天争命对抗天劫，就是渡劫”石头解释道。
虽然李磊不是那种贪生怕死之辈，但与其这样还不如另找出路比较可靠。
“有啊!小子，你只要跟本女王入了魔道，本女王保证，你和我准定能推翻那玉帝老儿的统治”
但李磊没有办法了，只好选择第一个了那就是渡劫成仙，因为李磊哪怕遭受痛苦，遭受磨难，甚至有可能会死，他李磊也绝对不会站在邪恶的一边。
“不用了，快开始!”还没等石头说完，李磊却急忙喊道。
因为李磊此时睁眼一看，孙志才等一众黑衣人已经开始冲入那道门了。
“快啊!他们来了!”李磊大喊道。
“哟!甚是悠闲啊”孙志才和黑衣人们互看一眼，二话不说纷纷冲向了李磊。
只见孙志才等人竟如同撞向无形的结界一般竟被弹飞开来，落地时更是七窍流血如同死狗一般爬在了地上。
“呼，好险，开始了吗”李磊长舒一口气。
忽然李磊只感觉有无数力量从他的心脏涌入四肢，进入根骨，融入灵魂，此时李磊的修为竟极速暴涨，当暴涨停止时李磊的修为已经不再是心动圆满而是大乘圆满的强者了。
“小子，你要想活着，你就要有那个信念，你一定不要忘记耻辱，仇恨是你活下去的唯一动力!开始!”那石头大喊道。
只见那峡谷上方的天空本来万里无云，可是忽然却完全相反，乌云滚滚，雷声四起，一股强大的威压席卷八方。
忽然一道光柱竟然穿透道道乌云竟把李磊笼罩了起来。
李磊的身子竟然不自主的飞了起来，朝着上方缓缓升去。
李磊环顾四周，他誓要记住这些黑衣人的面孔，他活不成也罢，只要他一旦渡劫成仙，日后此仇必报!
只见李磊的身子竟然穿透了屋顶飞到了半空之中。
此人李磊仿佛如同君王一样，俯视着周围那渺小的景物，俯视那如同蝼蚁一般的孙志才等人。

> Chapter 7 Begin to overcome the tribulation (Page 1)
Inside the door, Li Lei blended perfectly with the stone. Although the fusion had been successful, Li Lei still sat cross-legged and closed his eyes.
"By the way, I have something to tell you. Because your cultivation level is too weak, if you want to ascend to immortality, you must continuously survive the three-nine thunder tribulations that prevent the heartbeat stage from becoming the elixir formation stage, the six-nine thunder tribulations that prevent the out-of-body stage from becoming the clone stage, and the nine-nine thunder tribulations that prevent the Mahayana stage from transcending tribulations and becoming an immortal, before you can ascend."
"Each lightning tribulation is stronger than the last, not to mention that your heart-beating body is forcibly instilled with cultivation by this Queen. Even if your cultivation reaches Mahayana Perfection, your body cannot be Mahayana Perfection! And according to my speculation, you don't seem to have magic weapons and props to defeat it," Shitou said again.
"So difficult!" Li Lei couldn't help but frowned when he heard Shitou's words.
If Li Lei's current physical body survives the Three-Nine Thunder Tribulation, it is not too difficult, but the Six-Nine Thunder Tribulation and the Nine-Nine Thunder Tribulation are not good.
And the stone was right. Li Lei really didn't have any treasures that could help him overcome the calamity. To be precise, he not only had no treasures now, he didn't even have much silver on him.
"Of course, those who obey will be ordinary, but those who rebel will become immortals! Every breakthrough is undoubtedly a competition, so Heaven will not allow you to break through this limit, so Heaven will send a disaster to destroy you, and this disaster is the so-called Heavenly Tribulation. Fighting against the Heavenly Tribulation is to overcome the Tribulation," Shitou explained.
Although Li Lei is not the kind of person who is greedy for life and afraid of death, it is better to find another way out which is more reliable.
"Yes! Boy, as long as you enter the devil's way with this queen, I guarantee that you and I will definitely overthrow the rule of the Jade Emperor."
But Li Lei had no choice but to choose the first option, which was to overcome the calamity and become an immortal, because even if Li Lei suffered pain, suffering, or even died, he, Li Lei, would never stand on the side of evil.
"No, let's start!" Before Shitou could finish speaking, Li Lei hurriedly shouted.
Because when Li Lei opened his eyes at this time, he saw that Sun Zhicai and other men in black had already begun to rush into the door.
"Hurry! They are coming!" Li Lei shouted.
"Oh! It's so leisurely." Sun Zhicai and the people in black looked at each other and rushed towards Li Lei without saying anything.
I saw Sun Zhicai and others being bounced away as if they were hitting an invisible barrier. When they landed, they were bleeding from all their orifices and crawled on the ground like dead dogs.
"Huh, it's so dangerous, has it started yet?" Li Lei let out a long sigh of relief.
Suddenly, Li Lei felt countless power pouring into his limbs from his heart, entering his bones, and blending into his soul. At this time, Li Lei's cultivation level skyrocketed. When the surge stopped, Li Lei's cultivation level was no longer a perfect heartbeat, but a strong man with perfect Mahayana.
"Boy, if you want to live, you must have that belief. You must not forget the shame. Hatred is the only motivation for you to live! Start!" The stone shouted.
I saw that the sky above the canyon was originally cloudless, but suddenly it was completely opposite. Dark clouds were rolling, thunder was everywhere, and a powerful pressure swept across all directions.
Suddenly, a beam of light penetrated through the dark clouds and enveloped Li Lei.
Li Lei's body flew up involuntarily and slowly rose upwards.
Li Lei looked around, and he vowed to remember the faces of these men in black. It didn't matter if he lived or died, as long as he overcame the disaster and became an immortal, he would avenge this in the future!
Li Lei's body actually penetrated the roof and flew into the air.
This person, Li Lei, seemed to be like a king, looking down at the small scenery around him, looking down at Sun Zhicai and others who were like ants.
